About the Role
Wex is hiring a Software Development Engineer 1 to build and maintain backend services on our payments platform.

Qualifications
1+ years of software development experience
Proficiency in Java and Spring
Experience with AWS and SQL

Location
This is a remote role. To be eligible, the candidate must reside within 30 miles of Portland, ME; Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; Dallas, TX; the San Francisco Bay Area, CA; or Seattle, WA.

Benefits
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid time off and parental leave
Learning and development stipend
